attempts.action: Inspect the challenge ELF, menu operations, and supplied runtime archive
attempts.result: PIE, Full RELRO, NX, and canary are enabled; freed slots retain pointers and the bounds checker permits show/edit on freed slots; setup loads flag.txt into an unreachable 0x80 allocation
attempts.notes: The binary and runtime files were extracted and SHA-256 recorded. The bundled loader/libc pair did not run reliably together.

attempts.action: Run a local marker-only tcache-poison check with Kali WSL's system glibc
attempts.result: Recovered OWASP{LOCAL_TEST_MARKER} from the hidden allocation
attempts.notes: This verifies the primitive only; the marker is not the challenge flag.

attempts.action: Try the local runtime's fixed p0-minus-0x780 secret offset on the scoped service
attempts.result: The remote process closed before the poisoned allocation prompt; the local fixed offset was not portable
attempts.notes: No flag was claimed from this attempt.

attempts.action: Read from the leaked page base plus 0x10
attempts.result: The candidate read returned zero bytes; no flag was claimed
attempts.notes: The remote p0 address had page offset 0x510, unlike the local process layout.

attempts.action: Read aligned windows across the leaked heap page
attempts.result: The flag suffix appeared in one window, but the first runner printed only short previews and did not capture the complete value
attempts.notes: This identified the adjacent page offsets needed for an exact capture.

attempts.action: Read and concatenate the adjacent 0x70-byte windows at page offsets 0x240 and 0x2b0
attempts.result: The exact remote bytes matched OWASP{drink_fr0m_th3_p0is0n3d_tc4ch3}
attempts.notes: The flag was read from the scoped challenge service. Portal submission and acceptance remain unverified.
